title: Evaluate integer expressions
audience: Students with basic programming knowledge learning assembly
prerequisites: Bounded byte slices and logical read bounds
learningObjectives: Encode precedence and left association in parser calls and loops
Preserve local pending operations across recursion
Check every intermediate signed-word arithmetic result
Locate syntax, literal and operator failures precisely
Preserve the first failure in the specified evaluation procedure
Compare parser work while retaining complete behavior
